EPISODE #52
Daily Briefing
What the Culture's Talking About
October 8, 2025 • 5 minutes • Hosted by Victoria
Today's Briefing
Episode #52
0:000:00
About This Episode
The political streets are wild: Kamala Harris dropped a shocking quote, and we break down Trump's threat to use the Insurrection Act. Plus, we discuss why Trump is ignoring a Black woman running for Governor. Let’s chop it up!
Today's Highlights:
Blavity Daily Briefing breaks down the biggest stories affecting Black culture and our community.
New film ‘The Lost Bus’ highlights the extraordinary heroism and dedication of everyday school personnel.
Tune in now for the essential breakdown of cultural moments and high-stakes political drama coverage.
Blavity promises comprehensive coverage on major Hollywood narratives and vital political drama affecting us.
Culture briefing delivers crucial information and necessary dialogue impacting our collective community right now.
